svg.text: App constantly asks for the next batch of videos (read-ahead) so playback has no spinner

svg.text: Heavy video bytes never go through the app service; the app fetches each URL directly

Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: CDN serves popular videos from its regional cache, otherwise pulls from blob storage and may cache

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • 1B users in 150 countries, 1B views/day, 10B uploads/yr ≈ 30M/day ≈ 300/s (≈1k/s peak ≈ 10 Gbps ingress)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Storage: 10B × 1 MB = 10 PB/yr raw, ≈100 PB/yr with replication and encodings; metadata ≈ 10 TB; views ≈ 10k/s ≈ 100 Gbps egress

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Success metric: time in app (~1 h/day). Bottleneck: real-time feed generation → read-ahead, possibly run model on-device
